paragraphs.text: Goa Dabolim International Airport (GOI/VOGO) serves as a key air gateway for Vasco da Gama, IN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 08/26: 3458 m (11345 ft) asphalt.
Ground transportation options connecting Goa Dabolim International Airport with central Vasco da Gama include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from GOI should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Goa Dabolim International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Goa Dabolim International Airport is GOI and the ICAO code is VOGO.

faqs.q: Which city does GOI airport serve?
faqs.a: Goa Dabolim International Airport (GOI) serves Vasco da Gama, IN.
